description_for_model: Allows staff and leads to inspect enterprise AI token usage, costs across Claude and Gemini, and manage group capability controls with strict RBAC scoping.
description_for_human: View token usage, platform costs, top users, and capability controls for your team.

tools.name: usage_summary
tools.description: Returns AI token usage and costs across Claude and Gemini for a period and group.

group.description: Optional group ID. Defaults to caller's own group.

tools.name: top_users
tools.description: Rank seat holders by total token volume for a period.

tools.name: capability_status
tools.description: Inspect enable/disable state of capabilities for a group.

tools.name: set_capability
tools.description: Enable or disable a capability for a group (requires admin permissions in production).
